Optimal.Notes: This profile targets a stable 30 fps locked to a 40 Hz display, giving the smoothest perceived motion for the frame budget. Textures are kept at High since VRAM pressure is shared with system RAM, while foliage is dropped low to recover GPU headroom in outdoor areas.

profiles.Summary: Hogwarts Legacy is a demanding open-world RPG that pushes the Steam Deck hard; expect 30 fps at low-to-medium settings with FSR upscaling to stay playable. The game is Steam Deck Verified with full controller support, but the GPU requirements far exceed the Deck's capability, making aggressive settings reductions necessary.
profiles.BasisNote: No specific Steam Deck player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the PC minimum/recommended requirements versus the Deck's RDNA 2 GPU (roughly GTX 1050 Ti class). On your first run, check frame pacing in Hogsmeade and the open castle grounds — those are the heaviest areas — and drop to the Max Battery profile if the Optimal profile stutters.

MaxBattery.Notes: Render at 960x600 internally and let FSR do the upscaling work; capping TDP to 8 W and locking GPU clock keeps power draw low. Expect occasional dips below 30 fps in Hogsmeade — the 40 Hz refresh rate makes 30 fps feel smoother than 60 Hz would.

KnownIssues: The game is very GPU-heavy and can struggle to maintain stable 30 fps in dense open-world areas like Hogsmeade even at low settings.
Shader compilation stutters may occur early in the session until shaders are cached.
Ray tracing options (if present) must be disabled entirely on the Deck — the hardware cannot run them.
Long load times are common, especially from HDD-class storage; an SSD is strongly recommended.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Running the GPU at full 1600 MHz with no TDP cap extracts every frame the Deck can offer, but expect dips into the low 30s in the most demanding outdoor areas of the map. Battery life will be short — keep a charger handy for long sessions.

Optimal.Notes: A 12 W TDP with a locked 30 fps and FSR from 1024x640 gives a stable, playable experience with improved texture and effect quality over Max Battery. This is the best balance of image quality and consistency for most areas of the game.

profiles.Summary: Hogwarts Legacy is a demanding open-world RPG that runs on the Steam Deck but requires significant visual compromises — low settings and FSR upscaling are needed to maintain a stable 30 fps. The game is Steam Deck Verified and runs well under Proton, though performance can dip in denser areas of Hogsmeade and the open world.
profiles.BasisNote: No specific Steam Deck player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the PC minimum/recommended requirements (minimum GPU ~GTX 960, recommended ~GTX 1080 Ti), the Deck's RDNA 2 GPU (~GTX 1050 Ti class), and ProtonDB gold/platinum trending data. On first run, check frame rate in Hogsmeade — if it drops below 25 fps consistently, drop to Max Battery settings or reduce View Distance and Population Quality further.

MaxBattery.Notes: Rendering at 960x600 with FSR upscaling to 1280x800 and an 8 W TDP cap maximises battery life; expect occasional dips below 30 fps in Hogsmeade. Half-rate shading is left off as it causes visible artefacts in motion-heavy scenes.

KnownIssues: Performance can dip noticeably below 30 fps in Hogsmeade village and densely populated open-world areas
Shader compilation stutters may occur on first launch or when entering new areas
Some players report the game runs warm, pushing TDP limits and causing thermal throttling without a TDP cap
In-App Purchases and online connectivity prompts may appear on startup

MaxPerformance.Notes: Running at full 15 W TDP with a 40 Hz refresh and frame cap delivers the smoothest possible experience on Deck, but expect dips into the low 30s in Hogsmeade and busy outdoor areas; Foliage and Population are kept Low as they are the biggest GPU cost. Battery life will be short.
